checks.name: V1 [the generalisation, and it passes its three requirements] the family with mean occupancy Y^(d-2) is written down, reduced to three dimensions, expanded at small argument and taken to infinity
checks.measured: mu = 1 - 1/(Y**p + 1)**n with p = d - 2; at p = 1 (d = 3) minus the original family = 0; deep limit divided by n Y^p tends to {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1} for p = 1, 2, 3; saturation at p = 1 is 1
checks.reading: it reduces exactly to the family in three dimensions, carries the conformally invariant deep power in general, and still saturates at one. That is the object L238 asked for

checks.name: V2 [the count is a prefactor, and a prefactor cannot change a power] the deep-limit response is differentiated with respect to the mode count and with respect to the logarithm of the argument, to see which of the two the count can affect
checks.measured: d(deep)/dn divided by the occupancy = 1, a constant; and d log(deep)/d log Y = p, which is free of n
checks.reading: the mode count multiplies the deep response and does not touch its POWER. So the conformally invariant requirement mu ~ Y^(d-2) constrains the OCCUPANCY and says nothing whatever about the count, in any number of dimensions

checks.name: V3 [THE ROUTE L238 NAMED IS CLOSED] the hoped-for handle is stated and tested against V2, since the whole point of building the generalisation was to make the count dimension-dependent
checks.measured: L238 hoped a d-dimensional family would make the mode count depend on dimension and so become checkable. V2 shows the deep limit fixes the occupancy's power and leaves the count entirely free in every dimension
checks.reading: the generalisation exists and does not restore the handle. That route is closed, and closing it is worth as much as opening it would have been, because this programme was about to spend effort there

checks.name: V4 [the equipartition statement of L238 is specifically a three-dimensional one] the mean occupancy is evaluated across dimensions and its three-dimensional value compared with the linear form L238 derived
checks.measured: occupancy is Y^(d-2): constant at d = 2, linear at d = 3, quadratic at d = 4; L238's 'occupancy exactly linear in the acceleration' is the d = 3 case
checks.reading: so the counting statement L238 identified -- how many quanta of the dark-energy acceleration fit into this one -- is a fact about three dimensions rather than a general principle. In four it would be the square. That is a real sharpening of what the reading says

checks.name: V5 [the generalisation is unique if the photocount structure is kept] the alternative route to the deep power is stated and checked for whether it preserves the structure that made the reading meaningful
checks.measured: alternative: keep the occupancy linear and make the single-mode distribution non-geometric, with P(empty) = 1 - c Y^(d-2). That also reproduces the deep power, but it abandons the thermal single-mode structure, and with it the reason the composition law holds
checks.reading: so within the photocount reading the generalisation is forced, and outside it there is no reading left to generalise. Either way no dimensional handle on the count appears

checks.name: V6 [all four candidates survive, and none is now distinguishable even in principle by dimension] the candidate counts are re-evaluated at three dimensions and the number that the generalisation separates counted
checks.measured: 4 candidates, all giving 2 at d = 3: ['transverse directions (d-1)', 'graviton polarisations ((d+1)(d-2)/2)', 'screen dimensions (d-1)', 'branches of the gradient invariant (2)']; separated by the generalisation: 0
checks.reading: before this lane the dimension was a hypothetical discriminator that the reading happened not to survive. Now it is established that it was never a discriminator at all, because the count is dimensionally inert. The four candidates are degenerate

checks.name: V7 [what is left is the data, and only the data] the surviving routes to the mode count are listed after this lane and counted
checks.measured: 3 statements, all about measurement: the radial acceleration relation itself, which L232 already used and which prefers the count of two by 0.016 dex over the count of one; so sharpening it means beating that relation's intrinsic scatter, currently about 0.045 dex, by a factor of a few; which needs better mass-to-light ratios and distances rather than better theory
checks.reading: after four structural angles, twelve pre-registered criteria, two literature searches and now a dimensional generalisation, every route to the mode count that is not a measurement has been closed. The exponent is an empirical quantity and the honest thing is to treat it as one
